scope: Seven shortest canonical mechanics records after Batch 396

records.name: Kai Kai
records.mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Other Super. Teleports the user to a selected ally/partner rather than attacking the opponent; current repository evidence identifies Whis as the notable user and PQ63 as the acquisition endpoint.

records.name: Psycho Escape
records.mechanics_notes: 200-Stamina Other Evasive. Freezes the opponent during its escape sequence, breaks the opponent's lock-on, and relocates the user; current skill-specific evidence states it deals no damage. Community reports describe extended invulnerability during the time-stop portion, but that timing remains community evidence rather than a canonical frame claim.

records.name: Supernova Cooler
records.mechanics_notes: 500-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate. Throws a large, power-packed Ki blast; current Xenoverse 2 references identify mentor training with Cooler (Final Form) as the acquisition endpoint. Exact startup, tracking, damage, and charge-frame data remain bounded pending dedicated mechanics evidence.

records.name: Super Elite Combo
records.mechanics_notes: 300-Ki Strike Ultimate from Jaco Lesson 3. Performs a short rush followed by a ray-gun blast; maintained repository evidence documents three hits. Exact frame/damage breakdown remains bounded.

records.name: Energy Dome
records.mechanics_notes: Current mentor acquisition, skill identity, and Other classification are corroborated. The skill creates a defensive energy-dome effect; exact duration, damage reduction, and frame properties remain unresolved pending stronger current mechanics evidence.

records.name: Eye Beam
records.mechanics_notes: Current mentor acquisition, skill identity, and Ki classification are corroborated. Fires an eye-origin Ki attack; exact hit count, damage, tracking, and frame properties remain unresolved pending stronger current mechanics evidence.

records.name: One-Handed Kamehameha mk.II
records.mechanics_notes: Current mentor acquisition, skill identity, and Ki classification are corroborated. Fires a one-handed Kamehameha variant; exact charge, hit count, damage, and frame properties remain unresolved pending stronger current mechanics evidence.
